title: Director of Operations
text:
**Director of Operations**

South Florida, preferably Miami | On-site / field-based | $100,000–$120,000 base + performance-based annual bonus

**About Quest Workspaces**

Quest Workspaces is a leading provider of flexible offices and professional workspace solutions, with locations across Florida and New York. We deliver professional work environments with a hospitality-first approach.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a highly organized, execution-focused Director of Operations with a proven ability to translate plans into results. This hands-on, field-based leader will ensure our locations operate at a high operational standard, deliver projects on time, strengthen operating systems, and help ensure the Quest client experience is consistently executed. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this individual will work closely with center teams and cross-functional leaders throughout the organization to drive operational excellence, consistency, and accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Facilities & Center Operations*

· Oversee center presentation, preventive maintenance, repairs, safety and emergency preparedness; coordinate with property management and building personnel.

· Visit locations regularly, assess operating conditions, identify issues early, and work with center teams to drive timely resolution.

· Manage operational purchasing, equipment replacements, vendor performance and service agreements within approved budgets; identify cost savings without compromising quality or service.

*Regulatory Compliance & Licensing*

· Oversee municipal licenses, permits, Business Tax Receipts, Certificates of Use, fire inspections and related renewals, documentation and corrective actions.

· Coordinate Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) compliance, USPS documentation and reporting, and applicable insurance and vendor compliance requirements.

*Projects & New Center Openings*

· Lead new center openings, expansions, renovations, tenant improvements and capital projects from planning through completion.

· Manage contractors, competitive quotes, budgets, timelines, furniture procurement, deliveries and installations, minimizing disruption to center operations.

*Technology & Operational Systems*

· Coordinate operational technology and software implementation, adoption and troubleshooting with our technology coordinator, IT partners and center teams.

· Develop practical operating procedures, checklists and tracking tools; use approved AI and automation to simplify processes and improve efficiency.

*Hospitality & Client Experience*

· Proactively engage with clients and center teams to assess the overall client experience, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure consistent hospitality standards across all locations.

· Recommend and help implement enhancements to services, amenities, systems, and processes that streamline operations, reduce friction, and continuously elevate the client experience.

**What You Bring**

· 5+ years in multi-site operations, commercial facilities, hospitality, property operations, or a related field, with hands-on project ownership

· Strong organization, project management, vendor oversight, budgeting, and follow-through.

· Working knowledge of building systems, renovations, and business technology; working knowledge of AI and automation tools, with a proactive approach to learning and applying new technologies to improve efficiency.

· A genuine hospitality mindset, sharp eye for detail, clear communication, and ability to influence teams without direct authority.

· Prior experience managing teams, delegating responsibilities, and leading cross-functional initiatives.

· Experience coordinating municipal licensing, permitting and regulatory inspections across multiple commercial locations preferred.

· South Florida base and willingness to travel regularly to Quest locations throughout Florida and New York.

**Location & Travel**

This is not a remote position. Regular in-person center visits and travel to other Quest markets are required.

**Compensation**

Base salary: $100,000–$120,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus eligibility for a performance-based annual bonus under company policy.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your résumé and a brief summary of your multi-site operations and project experience through the platform where this position is posted.

*Quest Workspaces is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* What is the maximum number of commercial locations you have overseen simultaneously?
* Do you have hands-on experience managing new location openings, renovations, or expansion projects, including contractors and budgets?
* How many years of experience do you have in commercial facilities management, vendor management, and operational purchasing?
* Do you have experience managing business licensing, permitting, and regulatory inspections for commercial properties?
* Do you have experience implementing operational software, AI, or automation tools to improve business efficiency?

Experience:

* multi-site operations management: 5 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Miami, FL 33131 (Required)

Work Location: In person
